The '''grandfather''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sagoro Autem]] was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], protecting the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|legislators]]. Duty, honor, and loyalty to the Republic were deeply ingrained in his [[Autem family|family]]. His [[Sagoro Autem's father|son]] and grandson would later follow in his footsteps.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|sagoroautem|Autem, Sagoro}}</ref>
